context: a single passage from a letter by J. D. Hooker, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: I have been reading a capital paper at Berkeley’s on classification of vegetables, by poor Adrien de Jussieu in the Dict. Nouv. des Sc. Nat.— it is I suppose Js. last work. Brongnart has also a good paper in it on Fossil vegetables. I shall be really glad of the Balanidae book.— I have Part I. I often look at systematic Zoolog. books to see how matters & subjects are treated & I should have a real interest in the Balanidae besides

I am very glad you wish to have my Barnacle Book, for I would rather send it to you than to any half-dozen-others, if you cared to have it. Our old friend Arthrobalanus is now christened Cryptophialus. Under the Order to which it belongs, I discuss the (as it appears to me) very curious case of its affinities; I was most uncomfortably puzzled how to class it, & am far from sure that I decided correctly.—
